mapper.insert: INSERT INTO node_form(module_instance_id,node_id,round_no,form_json,submitted_by) VALUES(#{module},#{key},#{round},#{json},#{actor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE form_json=VALUES(form_json),submitted_by=VALUES(submitted_by)
mapper.update: UPDATE project_application SET title=COALESCE(#{draft.applicationTitle},title),limited_project=COALESCE(#{draft.isLimitedProject},limited_project), summary=COALESCE(#{draft.applicationSummary},summary),payload_json=#{json} WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} AND project_id=#{project}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_formacceptance_form (module_instance_id,round_no,payload_json) VALUES(#{module},#{round},#{json}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload_json=VALUES(payload_json)
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(id) FROM state_record WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} AND round_no=#{round}
mapper.update: UPDATE node_form SET form_json=#{json},submitted_by=#{actor} WHERE id=#{id} AND module_instance_id=#{module} AND node_id LIKE #{pattern} AND round_no=#{round}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM node_form WHERE id=#{id} AND module_instance_id=#{module} AND node_id LIKE #{pattern} AND round_no=#{round}
mapper.select: SELECT payload_json FROM project_application WHERE module_instance_id=#{module}

SELECT form_json FROM node_form WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} AND node_id IN (#{code},#{node}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,form_json FROM node_form WHERE module_instance_id=#{module} AND (node_id LIKE #{pattern} OR node_id=#{node}) ORDER BY id
